note: RV park beside the North Platte at the west edge of Glenrock. Mostly long-term: residents fill much of the upper full-hookup lot, and the primitive sites toward the river take most overnight guests. Dog park, playground, propane and storage. --Claude
summary: Operator site current (rates $35 primitive / $45 FHU, open year-round, Campspot booking). Long-stay heavy - reviews: 'Most of the people here live here year round'; online only 2-3 FHU + 24 primitive + 4 tent sites; nightly share ~half of ~57 sites, counting primitive and tent. Cheapest electric night $45 (all seasons) passes the price gate, but Google is only 4.0/143 - borderline for the reviewer. Not waterfront stands.
flags: CRITERIA - LONG-STAY (reviewer): recent Google reviews: 'Lots of permanent guests if that bothers you' (4/5, ~2 months ago); 'Most of the people here live here year round' (5/5, ~4 months ago). The FAQ tells guests to ship to 'your lot number' and the policies PDF covers 'Monthly reservations'. Nightly share: Campspot sells online 2-3 full-hookup pull-throughs, 24 primitive RV sites (no hookups) and 4 tent sites = ~30; imagery shows ~25 more sites in the upper full-hookup lot (~42.8687,-105.8790), mostly long-term rigs. ~50-55% nightly counting primitive and tent, but only ~3 of ~28 hookup sites are sold by the night. Passes tests 2 and 4 (posted nightly rate; well over 1 in 10); no wording discourages nightly guests.

PRICE (private, no gateway within 40 km): cheapest electric RV night $45 (FHU pull-through, same Oct 2026 / Jan 2027 / Jun 2027) - passes; no summer premium. Plus 3.5% card fee + $2 processing; 14.5% tax & fees. Not a Good Sam Park (gs false). Google 4.0 (143 reviews) - not under 4.0, but mediocre with a narrow-ish price pass: borderline for the reviewer. RV Life 4.5/$$ stored.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' stands for the hookup lot (~250 m from the river behind a treeline). Campspot lists 8 'Primative-River View - Back In' sites (no hookups, nightly) somewhere in the open field NW of the office toward the river (~42.8692,-105.8807); with no site map I could not place them - the riparian tree belt along the bank (~42.8694,-105.8820) sits between that field and the water, so at most a view value for those 8; no change proposed.
